verdict.rationale: Spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question for a paid inference API, so the axis applies. The evidence only says the console 'manages your keys and usage' and mentions tier limits 'on demand', which are adjacent usage and rate-limit features, not documented spending caps or budget alerts. With no evidence of the capability itself, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
